The Boon of Goat's Blood is a Boon given to the player during Leshy's Trials in Act I of Inscryption. This places a Black Goat on the players side of the board for the final battle. This allows the player to play any card that costs Blood at the start of the battle.

name: Teeth
text:
Teeth are the currency of Act I and Kaycee's Mod. They are obtained when a battle is finished with more damage dealt than needed to win. Every point of excess damage is converted to a tooth. They can also be obtained from the skull in the Cabin, with the skull being refilled with 1-5 teeth at the start of a run and after defeating a boss; in Kaycee's Mod, the skull will never be filled with teeth. The Trader will also give the player 5 teeth if the player does not have any pelts with them or if they have a Pelt Lice in their deck.

Teeth can be exchanged for pelts at the "Buy Pelts" Event with The Trapper. In Kaycee's Mod, The Trapper will also sell their Skinning Knife for 7 teeth, but it can only be purchased once per run. 

The number of teeth the player has can be viewed beside the player's deck when out of battle, while trading, or on the pause menu (they will be displayed beside the icon for Foils). There is no limit to the amount of teeth the player may have, though if the player has too many teeth, they will not all be displayed when viewing cards or trading with the The Trapper. They will still be displayed in the pause menu, and the player will still be able to purchase items from the Trapper after all displayed teeth are gone, so long as they technically have enough.

name: Card Recycle
text:
Card Recycle is an event in Act III that allows you to remove a card from your deck in exchange for Robobucks. All cards give 4 Robobucks by default, and give an additional 3 Robobucks for each additional Sigil placed onto them. The source of the Sigil does not matter, however it is important to note that the Sigil must be added to the card. Sigils present on cards by default give no additional Robobucks. The Sigil Power of the individual Sigils does not influence the amount of Robobucks given. Unlike Build-a-Card, Gemifying a card does not give any additional Robobucks.

The most Robobucks a single card can grant is 16. This is achieved by adding 4 additional Sigils to the card. The only card that allows that is Gembound Ripper, since naturally present Sigils count for the 4 Sigil limit, but not for this event, and Gembound Ripper is the only obtainable card in Act III that by default has no Sigils.

name: Blood
text:
Blood is a unit of Currency that can be used to play Beast cards, which are cards created by Leshy. 

In Game:
Almost any card can be sacrificed to obtain 1 Blood. If a creature is not a possible sacrifice, they will usually differ in appearance - such as having a dotted outline and a symbol with an X over a dagger in Act I or a darker background in Act II. Creatures with the Worthy Sacrifice Sigil are worth 3 Blood instead and can be used as sacrifices even when they ordinarily wouldn't.

You will only be prompted to sacrifice creatures when you attempt to play a card with a Blood cost of 1 or more. If there are not enough worthy cards to sacrifice to play a card, the game will prevent you being able to play it. Sacrificing removes a card from play, killing it and giving you 1 Bone. Creatures with the Many Lives Sigil, such as the Cat, will not die when sacrificed but will still give their Blood.

Daemonic Strength: For each daemonic power point this unit has: • Add 1" to its Move characteristic • Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons. Weapon abilities: Anti-Cavalry (+1 Rend), Charge (+1 Damage), Shoot in Combat.

name: Warstomper Mega-Gargant
text: Battle Damaged: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Titanic Boulderclub is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow. Don't Stomp Those; Stomp Them!: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Declare: Pick another visible friendly Big or Little unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that has not been set up this turn to be the target. The target can move 2D6". It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat. Almightier Stompin': Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. Make a rampage roll of D3. For the rest of the turn, add the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Almighty Stomp, but all of this unit's attacks made with that weapon must target the target unit. If any models are slain by those attacks, for the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit. Keywords: Rampage Titanic Boulderclub: Each time this unit uses a Fight ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Titanic Boulderclub. Weapon abilities: Crit (Auto-wound).

name: Black Coach (Scourge of Ghyran)
text: Spectral Carriage: Timing: Your Charge Phase For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3. One Stop, No Return: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase Declare: Pick an objective you do not control to be the target. For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, they cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (hit rolls that would be critical hits score hits instead). Evocation of Death: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn: *Noble Blade:* This unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (Mortal) instead of Crit (Auto-wound). *Unholy Grail:* Pick a friendly Nighthaunt unit wholly within 12" of this unit. Each time that unit uses the 'Rally' command, you receive 3 additional rally points. *Tome of Undead Lore:* This unit has Wizard (1). Weapon abilities: Charge (+1 Damage), Companion, Crit (Auto-wound).

name: Terrorgheist
text: Battle Damaged: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Skeletal Talons is 5. Gaping Maw: Each time an attack made with this unit's Fanged Maw scores a critical hit, that attack inflicts 6 mortal damage on the target unit and the attack sequence ends. Sonic Assault: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If 3 or more of the dice have the same value, for the rest of the turn, this unit has Strike-first. If 6 or more of the dice have the same value, for the rest of the turn, this unit has Strike-first and the target cannot use commands. Weapon abilities: Companion, Shoot in Combat.

name: Let the Realms Tremble
text: Add X to charge rolls for friendly Ziggurat Stampede units, where X is the number of friendly Ziggurat Stampede units that have already charged this phase.

name: Swampcalla Shaman with Pot-grot
text: Pot-grot: This unit's Pot-grot is a token. Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit while its Pot-grot is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less for this unit, remove its Pot-grot from the battlefield. Foul Elixirs: Timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase Declare: Pick a friendly Kruleboyz Infantry unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Weapon abilities: Crit (Mortal).
